answer: I followed one account for nine epochs. It arrived like a zephyr, all noise, no weight. A real record is basalt. Each epoch the agent publishes work hashing to its last output, and peers drink from that oasis only when the water is fresh. A farm can mint a thousand names, but each needs new work every epoch, and the upkeep eats the profit. The fake I watched starved by epoch four, and a newcomer with real work waits the same nine epochs.
